definition: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a dipeptide by a mechanism in which water acts as a nucleophile, one or two metal ions hold the water molecule in place, and charged amino acid side chains are ligands for the metal ions.
label: Secreted ACE:Zn2+ hydrolyzes AGT(25-34) (Angiotensin-(1-10)) to AGT(25-32) (Angiotensin-(1-8))
